catalogue_meta.name: Free-For-Dev Tool Catalogue
catalogue_meta.description: Curated catalogue of free SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS offerings for autonomous agents to discover, assess, and integrate.

tools.name: Brave Search API
tools.description: Independent web, news, image, video search and AI/LLM context API suitable for RAG pipelines and AI agents.
tools.free_tier: $5 in monthly credits, credit card required for verification.

tools.name: Firecrawl
tools.description: API that crawls websites and converts them into clean, LLM-ready markdown or structured data, handling JavaScript rendering, proxies, and rate limits.
tools.free_tier: 1,000 credits per month, no credit card required.

tools.name: Tavily AI
tools.description: API for online search and rapid insights with comprehensive research capabilities and organized results.
tools.free_tier: 1,000 requests/month, no credit card required.

tools.name: Abstract API
tools.description: API suite for various use cases including IP geolocation, phone number validation, and email validation.
tools.free_tier: 1,000 free requests per month across services.

tools.name: Hugging Face
tools.description: Platform to build, train, and deploy NLP models for PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX.
tools.free_tier: Free up to 30k input characters/month on Inference API.

tools.name: Google Colab
tools.description: Free web-based Python notebook environment with Nvidia Tesla K80 GPU.
tools.free_tier: Free Jupyter Notebooks with GPU access.

tools.name: Cloudflare Workers
tools.description: Deploy serverless code for free on Cloudflare's global network.
tools.free_tier: 100k daily requests free.

tools.name: Cloudflare Pages
tools.description: Develop and deploy web apps on Cloudflare's fast, secure global network with free SSL and custom domains.
tools.free_tier: 500 monthly builds, 100 custom domains.

tools.name: Vercel
tools.description: Frontend cloud platform for static sites and serverless functions with global CDN.
tools.free_tier: Unlimited static sites, 100GB bandwidth/month, serverless functions.

tools.name: Netlify
tools.description: Platform for automating modern web projects with continuous deployment from Git.
tools.free_tier: Unlimited sites, 100GB bandwidth/month, 300 build minutes/month.

tools.name: GitHub Pages
tools.description: Static site hosting service directly from GitHub repositories.
tools.free_tier: Unlimited public repos, free custom domains with SSL.

tools.name: Google Cloud Run
tools.description: Fully managed container platform for deploying and scaling applications.
tools.free_tier: 2 million requests/month, 360k GB-seconds memory, 180k vCPU-seconds.

tools.name: AWS Lambda
tools.description: Serverless compute service that runs code in response to events.
tools.free_tier: 1 million requests per month free.

tools.name: Azure Functions
tools.description: Event-driven serverless compute platform for running code on-demand.
tools.free_tier: 1 million requests per month.

tools.name: Gitpod
tools.description: Open-source platform for automated, ready-to-code development environments in the cloud.
tools.free_tier: 50 hours/month free for public repos.

tools.name: GitHub Codespaces
tools.description: Instant dev environments in the cloud, pre-configured with your repo.
tools.free_tier: 60 hours/month free for personal accounts.

tools.name: Replit
tools.description: Browser-based IDE and hosting platform for running and sharing code.
tools.free_tier: Free tier with limited resources and public repls.

tools.name: Postman
tools.description: Collaboration platform for API development with free app and cloud features.
tools.free_tier: Free forever with certain limits.

tools.name: Insomnia
tools.description: Open-source API client for designing and testing APIs, supports REST and GraphQL.
tools.free_tier: Open source, free to use.

tools.name: Hoppscotch
tools.description: A free, fast, and beautiful API request builder.
tools.free_tier: Open source, free to use.

tools.name: JSONPlaceholder
tools.description: Free fake REST API for testing and prototyping with JSON placeholder data.
tools.free_tier: Free, no auth required.

tools.name: ReqRes
tools.description: Free hosted REST API for testing and prototyping with realistic responses.
tools.free_tier: Free, no auth required.

tools.name: Disease.sh
tools.description: Free API providing accurate data for building Covid-19 related applications.
tools.free_tier: Free, no auth required.

tools.name: IP-API
tools.description: IP Geolocation API free for non-commercial use, no API key required.
tools.free_tier: 45 req/minute from same IP, free for non-commercial use.

tools.name: IPAPI
tools.description: Reliable IP Address Location API built on AWS, offering 30k lookups/month without signup.
tools.free_tier: 30k lookups/month, no signup required.

tools.name: MockAPI
tools.description: Simple tool to quickly mock up APIs, generate custom data, and perform RESTful operations.
tools.free_tier: 1 project, 2 resources per project.

tools.name: OCR.Space
tools.description: OCR API that parses image and PDF files and returns text results in JSON format.
tools.free_tier: 25,000 requests per month, 1MB file size limit.

tools.name: CurrencyScoop
tools.description: Realtime currency data API for fintech applications.
tools.free_tier: 5,000 calls per month.

tools.name: Resend
tools.description: Email API for developers to send transactional and marketing emails.
tools.free_tier: 100 emails/day, 1 custom domain.

tools.name: SendGrid
tools.description: Cloud-based email delivery and management service for transactional and marketing emails.
tools.free_tier: 100 emails/day for 30 days, then limited free tier.

tools.name: Telegram Bot API
tools.description: HTTP API for building Telegram bots with messaging, inline keyboards, and media support.
tools.free_tier: Free, no cost for bot API usage.

tools.name: Twilio
tools.description: Cloud communications platform for SMS, voice, and email APIs.
tools.free_tier: Trial account with $15.50 credit, then pay-as-you-go.

tools.name: Slack API
tools.description: Platform for building Slack integrations, bots, and workflows.
tools.free_tier: Free tier with message limits and standard features.

tools.name: Discord API
tools.description: API for building Discord bots and integrations with rich media support.
tools.free_tier: Free, no cost for bot usage.

tools.name: Supabase
tools.description: Open-source Firebase alternative with PostgreSQL database, auth, and real-time subscriptions.
tools.free_tier: 500MB database, 50MB storage, 10k monthly active users, 2GB bandwidth.

tools.name: Firebase
tools.description: Google's mobile and web application development platform with Firestore and hosting.
tools.free_tier: 1GB storage, 50k reads/day, 20k writes/day, 10GB egress/month.

tools.name: PlanetScale
tools.description: Serverless MySQL platform with branching, non-blocking schema changes, and autoscaling.
tools.free_tier: 1 database, 5GB storage, 1 billion row reads/month, 10 million writes/month.

tools.name: Neon
tools.description: Serverless Postgres platform with branching, autoscaling, and pay-per-use pricing.
tools.free_tier: 3 projects, 10GB total storage, 100h compute/month.

tools.name: Railway
tools.description: Infrastructure platform for deploying code with GitHub integration and built-in databases.
tools.free_tier: 512MB RAM, 1GB storage, 1 CPU, $5 free credit/month.

tools.name: Render
tools.description: Cloud platform for deploying web services, databases, and static sites with auto-deploy from Git.
tools.free_tier: Free web services, static sites, and PostgreSQL databases with limitations.

tools.name: Fly.io
tools.description: Platform for running full-stack apps and databases close to users with global edge network.
tools.free_tier: 3 shared VMs, 3GB persistent storage, 160GB outbound transfer.

tools.name: GitHub Actions
tools.description: Automate any workflow with CI/CD directly integrated into GitHub repositories.
tools.free_tier: 2,000 minutes/month for public repos, free for private repos in organizations.

tools.name: GitLab CI/CD
tools.description: Built-in CI/CD for GitLab with pipelines, auto DevOps, and deployment automation.
tools.free_tier: 400 minutes/month for private projects, unlimited for public.

tools.name: CircleCI
tools.description: CI/CD platform for engineering teams to build, test, and deploy software.
tools.free_tier: 6,000 credits/month, 1 job at a time for free tier.

tools.name: Travis CI
tools.description: CI/CD service for building and testing software projects hosted on GitHub and GitLab.
tools.free_tier: Free for open source projects, 10,000 credits/month for trial.

tools.name: Datadog
tools.description: Monitoring and analytics platform for cloud-scale applications with logs, metrics, and APM.
tools.free_tier: 1 host, custom metrics, log management, infrastructure monitoring with 1-day retention.

tools.name: Sentry
tools.description: Error tracking and performance monitoring platform with real-time error alerts.
tools.free_tier: 5k errors/month, 1 project, 1 user, 14-day data retention.

tools.name: UptimeRobot
tools.description: Service to monitor website uptime, downtime, and performance with alerts.
tools.free_tier: 50 monitors, 5-minute check interval, email alerts.

tools.name: Logflare
tools.description: Cloud logging service with real-time log streaming and analytics.
tools.free_tier: 1GB/month ingestion, 1GB/month egress, 7-day retention.

tools.name: Papertrail
tools.description: Cloud log management service to aggregate and search logs from any source.
tools.free_tier: 100MB/month, 7-day retention, 1-day search.

tools.name: Auth0
tools.description: Identity platform for authentication and authorization with social login, MFA, and SSO.
tools.free_tier: 7,000 active users/month, 2 social connections, unlimited logins.

tools.name: Clerk
tools.description: Complete user management and authentication platform with pre-built UI components.
tools.free_tier: 10,000 monthly active users, unlimited organizations.

tools.name: Cloudflare Zero Trust
tools.description: Zero Trust security platform with access control, VPN replacement, and network protection.
tools.free_tier: Up to 50 users, 24 hours of activity logging, 3 network locations.

tools.name: Let's Encrypt
tools.description: Free, automated, and open Certificate Authority providing TLS certificates.
tools.free_tier: Free certificates, 90-day validity with auto-renewal.

tools.name: GitHub
tools.description: Code hosting platform with unlimited public and private repos, CI/CD, and collaboration tools.
tools.free_tier: Unlimited public and private repos, 500MB GitHub Pages storage, Actions minutes.

tools.name: GitLab
tools.description: Complete DevOps platform with Git repo management, CI/CD, and security scanning.
tools.free_tier: Unlimited public and private repos, 400 CI minutes/month, 5GB storage.

tools.name: Bitbucket
tools.description: Git repository hosting with integrated CI/CD, project management, and Jira integration.
tools.free_tier: 5 users, 1GB Git LFS, 50 build minutes/month.

tools.name: Codeberg
tools.description: Unlimited public and private Git repos for free and open-source projects with unlimited collaborators.
tools.free_tier: Unlimited repos, CI/CD, static hosting, package registry.
